channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Top 6 firms add Rs 75,257 crore in market value
item.description: The benchmark Sensex fell 338.3 points, or 0.39 per cent, during the week -- reflecting cautious sentiment among investors. Among the major gainers, Tata Consultancy Services saw its market valuation rise by Rs 22,594.96 crore to Rs 11,87,673.41 crore.

item.title: India hits out at 'misleading propaganda' on protest outside B'desh High Commission in Delhi
item.description: This comes a day after protests erupted outside the Bangladesh High Commission, demanding accountability for the rising cases of violence against Hindu minorities in the neighbouring nation.

item.title: Gold rises to record high over strong safe haven demand
item.description: In 2025, gold has seen a meteoric rise, up around 67 per cent amid geopolitical uncertainties and tariffs. According to analysts, gold and silver prices advanced last week and began the new week by touching fresh lifetime highs in both domestic and international markets.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open in green zone amid positive global cues
item.description: Analysts noted that market is likely heading for a year-end rally. The rupee's sharp reversal and FIIs' cash market purchases can accelerate this rally, as they lead to short covering, pushing benchmark indices higher. The Goldilocks domestic economic set up and potential earnings growth uptrend can support a market upturn, they added.

item.title: Air India Mumbai flight returns safely to Delhi after take-off due to tech issue
item.description: "The crew operating flight AI887 from Delhi to Mumbai on 22 December decided to return to Delhi shortly after take-off due to a technical issue as per standard operating procedure. The aircraft landed safely at Delhi and the passengers and crew have disembarked. Air India sincerely regrets inconvenience caused due to this unforeseen situation," an airline spokesperson said in a statement.

item.title: Mahayuti surges past 200-mark as BJP dominates Maharashtra local body polls
item.description: In terms of overall control of local bodies, the BJP-led Mahayuti alliance is ahead in 214 local bodies, while the opposition Maha Vikas Aghadi is leading in 52. Held after a gap of nearly a decade, the local body elections are being closely watched as an important barometer to assess which political forces hold sway in Maharashtra's semi-urban and rural regions.

item.title: UltraTech Cement faces Rs 390 crore GST demand
item.description: Along with this, the company has also been asked to pay a penalty of a similar amount and interest of around Rs 28 lakh. In a regulatory filing, UltraTech Cement Ltd said the demand relates to alleged short payment of Goods and Services Tax, improper use of input tax credit and other related issues.

item.title: Cong insulted Bhupen Hazarika, opposed semiconductor industry in Assam: PM Modi
item.description: "Congress backed the infiltrators who have destroyed the demography of Assam because those infiltrators are the vote bank of the opposition party. The BJP, on the contrary, has always been protective about ensuring the rights of people of Assam," he said, adding that the current dispensation has been working tirelessly to protect the indigenous people of the state.

item.title: Tamannaah Bhatia's weight loss: B'day girl stuns in mini dress, parties with Mrunal Thakur, Ranveer Allahbadia [Then and Now pics]
item.description: Take a look at inside photos and videos of Tamannaah Bhatia's 36th birthday celebration with Mrunal Thakur, Siddhant Chaturvedi and Pragya Kapoor.

item.title: Indian rupee rises for 2nd session amid RBI interventions
item.description: Analysts noted that volatility remains the main focus amidst rupee's comeback and follow‑through in RBI actions and global dollar moves remains crucial in near future. Currency market watchers said 89.20 has emerged as a crucial level and a sustained break below this could open the door toward the 88.50–88.30 zone in the near term.
